**Repair release. The Inquisition's dungeon, and one of ours.**

## The lesson nobody could pass

The jailor in the Inquisition Chambers has a whole training arc for a member of the
Inquisition: ask for the Rites of Confession, take the cell keys, go and talk to the damned,
come back and tell him what you learned. Three prisoners to question; a lesson with three
Speech tiers paying up to 250 XP and a trinket at the top -- *"don't forget about me when you
make Monsignor!"* All of it built. None of it reachable: the reply that opens the lesson
requires a flag the training was supposed to set, and nothing ever set it. Every Inquisitor
who did the work came back to a jailor offering the training again.

It works now. On the same shape, the Templar / Speech inspection route was written to be
once-only and was not, and a player who got keys that way was then told they could not open
the cells. Fixed.

## One of ours

0.10.0's needle trap at Montserrat wrote a line for stepping on it and never played it. The
build check caught it; it plays.

## Installing

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. It installs over any earlier release. The jailor's
fixes are dialogue and work on any save; the needle trap takes effect on a character who has
not yet entered Montserrat's first hall.
